name: lucid
description: Lucid used standalone (no AdonisJS application), through its Database, BaseModel and managed-transaction APIs.

modes.description: Lucid's defaults, with the managed transaction API db.transaction(callback).
An application-level mitigation (reused experiment LT1c): the transaction callback ends with `select 1`, so an aborted transaction throws instead of returning.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: Lucid has no propagation modes and no deferred writes: a nested trx.transaction() is always a savepoint, and every write is sent when it is made. An independent transaction is an unrelated db.transaction() on another connection, which shares no pending writes with the outer one, so the hazard TX-04.3 targets (pending outer writes committed by the inner transaction) cannot arise.
